caption:
Hope for the heavy heart: the opening of Surah Ad-Dhuhaa.

Allah reassured His Prophet ﷺ that his Lord had not forsaken him nor hated him, that the Hereafter would be better for him than the present life, and that his Lord would give him so much that he would be well pleased. Let these words stay with you when a season feels heavy.

Surah Ad-Dhuhaa 93:1-5

Send this to someone who needs a reminder of hope today.

#quranreels #surahduha #hope #heavyheart

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: By the morning brightness; and by the night when it is still; your Lord has not forsaken you [O Prophet], nor does He hate you; the Hereafter is better for you than the present life; and your Lord will certainly give you so much that you will be well pleased (Surah Ad-Dhuhaa 93:1-5)
